details: Chinese President Xi Jinping warned former U.S. President Donald Trump that mishandling the Taiwan issue could lead to conflict during their summit in Beijing. While the leaders discussed trade, technology, and regional stability, no major breakthroughs were announced, with the focus largely on maintaining a de-escalation framework rather than a comprehensive trade deal.
title: Xi Warns Trump on Taiwan as Beijing Summit Concludes

details: The U.S. has intensified pressure on Iran through new sanctions targeting entities involved in Iranian oil sales to China. Reports also indicate Saudi Arabia carried out covert strikes on Iranian targets, and President Trump warned the situation with Iran is at a critical point. These developments contribute to elevated oil prices and concerns about the stability of the Strait of Hormuz, a crucial global oil transit chokepoint.
title: US Sanctions Iran, Raising Oil & Inflation Concerns

details: Hotter-than-expected U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) data, surging 6% year-over-year, has reinforced concerns that the Federal Reserve may maintain elevated interest rates for longer than anticipated. This macroeconomic trend reduces liquidity in financial markets and makes safer fixed-income investments more attractive compared to volatile assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: US Inflation Surges, Raising Rate Hike Fears
